useWhen: Group Sentry envelopes, event JSON or /events/ responses an operator already holds into issues, or decide priority and status transitions with mihari rules
avoidWhen: Reading from or writing to a live Sentry organization, or assuming the result matches Sentry's own priority algorithm

inputs.text: Sentry envelope, event JSON or /events/ response text (<= 5 MiB)
inputs.decision: level, counts, status and action in Sentry vocabulary

outputs.issues: Sentry API-shaped issue objects with counts and first/last seen
outputs.decision: priority, next status and regression flag

authority.binding: caller-authorized profile mcp_servers entry and owner-reviewed effective tool allowlist

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-22: tools/list and tools/call over stdio with the itonami-agent MCP client (kotoba-lang/itonami-agent 709c948, itonami.agent.mcp discover/call) on synthetic fixtures; no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. itonami-agent exposes the tools as mcp__mihari__<tool> and does not start MCP subprocesses on peer runs. Data-format compatibility only; no connection to sentry.io.
requires: cloud-itonami/app-itonami-mihari checkout at the pinned commit

launchResolution.behavior: Resolve the absolute checkout before writing the client config. The launcher finds nbb.edn from its own path and resolves the pinned kotoba-lang/text git dependency into ~/.gitlibs; no cwd is required.
